title: Suction gripper head with a foam body

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
features.note: The reference describes a foam body as a carrier, but it does not describe a housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping.

features.item: An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.quote: The suction block 4 is optionally a vacuum generator, such as a compressed air vacuum generator. For example, the vacuum generator is a Venturi effect vacuum generator.
features.note: The reference discloses a vacuum generator in the housing, but it specifies a compressed air or Venturi effect vacuum generator, not an electrically operated one.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe a hollow grip portion or exhaust air being guided through it.

features.item: A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip portion or a sound-damping device arranged within it.

features.item: A suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to the carrier plate extending around it
features.quote: The soleplate 14 is preferably not fastened directly to the carrier (or else it is not entirely fastened directly to the carrier), but rather it is fastened to said carrier via a plate 18 .
features.note: The reference describes a soleplate (seal) fastened to a plate (carrier plate).
features.refuted: The quote describes a soleplate fastened via a plate to a carrier, not a seal fastened to a carrier plate extending around it.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip unit with a hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through the grip, or a sound-damping device in the grip.

features.item: Vacuum handling apparatus with suction plate and grip unit combined
features.quote: A suction gripper head comprising at least one carrier and a soleplate ( 14 ) for resting against an item to be lifted, the soleplate being arranged in the bottom portion of the carrier.
features.note: The reference describes a suction gripper head which is a vacuum handling apparatus with a soleplate (suction plate) and a carrier (grip unit).
features.refuted: The quote describes only a suction gripper head with carrier and soleplate, but does not mention a grip unit being combined with it.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip portion or sound-damping material lining it.

features.item: Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.quote: Preferably, the suction block 104 is arranged at least in part inside the carrier, and it is preferably arranged inside the carrier so that it does not project therefrom.
features.note: The reference states the suction block (vacuum generating device) is arranged at least in part inside the carrier (housing), but not necessarily completely within a 'first housing portion' as a distinct concept.

features.item: Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
features.quote: Optionally, a sound attenuation module 106 of the suction block 104 , of the silencer type, is also received in the first housing 105 .
features.note: The reference mentions a sound attenuation module in the first housing, which is a sound-reducing device, but does not explicitly state the housing portion is lined with sound-reducing material.

features.item: Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip portion elongated between housing portions with an air outlet on a second housing portion.

features.item: Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not describe an air collection screw or a grip portion.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip portion or bent/curved air baffles directing exhaust air.

features.item: Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not describe a battery coupling point or air baffles directing exhaust air away from it.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference describes a suction gripper head as a single unit, not a grip unit and suction plate releasably connected.

features.item: Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.quote: a suction path arranged therein between the soleplate and an outlet orifice of the gripper head for connection to a suction block
features.note: The reference describes a suction path from the soleplate (suction plate) to a suction block (part of the grip unit), indicating a fluidic connection.
features.refuted: The quote describes a suction path between soleplate and outlet orifice, not a suction opening connected to a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate.

claims.note: The reference describes a suction gripper head, not specifically a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device, nor does it mention a suction plate in the context of the grip unit itself.

claims.quote: The suction block 4 is optionally a vacuum generator, such as a compressed air vacuum generator.
claims.note: The reference discloses a vacuum generating device (suction block) but does not specify it as electrically operated, nor does it describe a housing with a grip portion for gripping the unit.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet. It focuses on the suction path.

claims.quote: Optionally, a sound attenuation module 106 of the suction block 104 , of the silencer type, is also received in the first housing 105 .
claims.note: The reference discloses a sound attenuation module (sound-damping device) within a housing, but it does not specify that this housing is a 'grip portion' or that exhaust air is guided through it.
The reference does not disclose the grip portion being lined with a sound-damping material.

claims.quote: The suction block 104 is arranged in such a manner that its top face is substantially level with the top face 102 of the body 101 , with the remainder of the suction block 104 being housed inside the body
claims.note: The reference discloses the vacuum generating device (suction block) being arranged at least partially inside a body (housing), but not necessarily *completely* within a *first housing portion* as specified in the claim.

claims.quote: Optionally, a sound attenuation module 106 of the suction block 104 , of the silencer type, is also received in the first housing 105 .
claims.note: The reference discloses a sound attenuation module (sound-reducing device) being received in a first housing, but it does not mention the first housing portion being lined with sound-reducing material.

This reference describes a suction gripper head with a foam body and a soleplate, but does not describe a grip unit with an elongated grip portion between a first and second housing portion, nor an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.

This reference describes a suction gripper head, but does not disclose an air collection device in the form of an air collection screw arranged upstream of a grip portion in a first housing portion for collecting exhaust air.

This reference describes a suction gripper head, but does not disclose bent or curved air baffles arranged downstream of a grip portion in a second housing portion for guiding exhaust air to an air outlet.

This reference describes a suction gripper head, but does not disclose a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery on a housing, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a coupling point.
The reference does not disclose air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.

claims.quote: A gripper system comprising a gripper structure and the gripper head according to claim 1 .
claims.note: The reference discloses a gripper system comprising a gripper structure and a gripper head, which is equivalent to a vacuum handling apparatus.
claims.refuted: The assertion describes a 'vacuum handling apparatus comprising', while the quote describes 'A gripper system comprising a gripper structure and the gripper head'. These are different entities, even if related.

claims.quote: Preferably, the bottom face of the carrier does not come to bear directly against an item to be lifted. Thus, the gripper head includes a soleplate 14 secured to the body 1
claims.note: The reference discloses a soleplate (carrier plate) secured to the body, but does not explicitly mention a seal fastened to the carrier plate and extending around it.
The full text of claim 1 for the subject invention was not provided, so it is not possible to assess if this reference discloses it.
The reference describes various ways to fasten components within the gripper head, but it does not explicitly mention a releasable coupling device between a grip unit and a suction plate.

claims.refuted: The assertion describes a 'grip unit' with a 'suction opening' connected to a 'suction chamber' to generate a vacuum between a 'suction plate' and an 'object to be lifted'.
